description: This file contains utility functions for reading and writing data to file descriptors and sockets, including functions for reading exact amounts, writing all data, and sending/receiving data over sockets, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes the entire buffer to the given SharedFD, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the SharedFD into a buffer, handling partial reads and errors.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all available data from the SharedFD into a string.

methods.name: ReadExact (overload with std::string*)
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes into a std::string.

methods.name: ReadExact (overload with std::vector<char>*)
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes into a std::vector<char>.

methods.name: WriteAll (overload with std::string_view)
methods.description: Writes the entire contents of a string view to the SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAll (overload with std::vector<char>)
methods.description: Writes the entire contents of a vector of chars to the SharedFD.

methods.name: SendAll
methods.description: Sends the entire message over a socket, handling partial sends and errors.

methods.name: RecvAll
methods.description: Receives a specified amount of data from a socket into a string.
